posts.author: Quicko
posts.text: ⚠️[Black money penalty]Review US account support article — Hello @BB789 As per the Income tax act, if a resident and ordinarily resident (ROR) customer’s Global account stayed open at any time during the calendar year, it should be reported in Table A2 of Schedule FA, even with a nil balance. Reason: Table A2 covers custodial accounts held at any time during the calendar year. It asks for the opening date, peak balance and closing balance, and nil is a valid entry.
